seo.title: Sacraments
seo.description: How to schedule a baptism or wedding at Saint Anthony of Padua Parish in Dois Vizinhos: dates, preparation and required documents.

hero.title: The most important moments of your life of faith.
hero.lead: Dates, preparation and required documents, explained simply. Tick each item on the list as you gather it.

checklist.title: Required documents
checklist.hint: This list is just to help you get organized. Bring the documents to the parish office.

baptism.title: Baptism
baptism.lead: The first sacrament, the doorway to Christian life. Parents and godparents attend preparation sessions before the celebration.
documents: Up-to-date tithe receipt for parents and godparents
Proof that godparents attended the preparation
Religious marriage certificate of the parents and/or godparents
notes: Parents or godparents from another parish must bring an authorization signed by their parish priest.
Contact the parish office in advance to book the date and the preparation sessions.
baptism.whatsappMessage: Hello! I'd like information about scheduling a baptism.

marriage.title: Wedding
marriage.lead: The sacrament that unites the couple before God and the community. The couple attends marriage preparation and submits documents in advance.
documents: Baptism and confirmation certificates of the couple
Up-to-date tithe receipt for the couple
Copy of the couple's ID and CPF
Proof of address for the couple
Proof of address for the witnesses
Copy of the sponsors' ID and CPF
Proof of the sponsors' religious marriage
notes: Other days and times can be arranged directly with the priests.
Convalidation is the religious ceremony for couples already living together or married only civilly.
marriage.whatsappMessage: Hello! I'd like information about getting married at the parish.

others.title: We are with you in these moments too.
others.lead: First Communion and Confirmation happen through catechesis. For confession and anointing of the sick, reach out to the priests.

eucharist.title: First Communion
eucharist.description: Preparation through parish catechesis, with classes for children and teenagers.

confirmation.title: Confirmation
confirmation.description: Confirmation of faith for teens, young people and adults, with registration through catechesis.

confession.title: Confession
confession.description: The priests are available on Wednesdays. During Lent and Advent there are special confession days.

anointing.title: Anointing of the sick
anointing.description: For the sick and elderly. In an emergency, contact the parish office to call a priest.
